item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Sharif affirmatively protected satire or investigative journalism. The positive side is thin: coalition bargaining after a hung parliament and one peaceful-local-dialogue item in Azad Kashmir. On balance, the evidence points to restricted tolerance, especially around protest, civil-society monitoring, and critical media.","evidence":[{"title":"Shehbaz Sharif to be coalition candidate for next Pakistan PM -spokeswoman","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/shehbaz-sharif-to-be-coalition-candidate-for-next-pakistan-pm-spokeswoman/1965379/","summary":"Weak positive only: after a hung parliament, Sharif’s return depended on coalition bargaining, so power remained procedurally contestable. This is not proof he welcomed criticism or monitoring, but it is the closest pro-tolerance item for opposition victories.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","4B.1"]},{"title":"PM Shehbaz urges AJK govt, political leadership to resolve issues through dialogue","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-05-12","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/12-05-2024/pm-shehbaz-urges-ajk-govt-political-leadership-to-resolve-issues-through-dialogue","summary":"Narrow positive: Sharif told party and local leaders to negotiate with the Azad Kashmir action committee and resolve the dispute peacefully. That shows some willingness to avoid coercion in a live protest-like flare-up, but it is a localized exception, not a general tolerance posture.","question_ids":["4B.3","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on people’s rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/","summary":"Clear negative: the election-day telecom and mobile internet shutdown chilled expression, assembly, and monitoring at a politically sensitive moment. Amnesty treated it as a rights violation, cutting against tolerance for criticism and civil-society scrutiny.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Social media platform X blocked in Pakistan over national security, ministry says","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-17","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/social-media-platform-x-blocked-in-pakistan-over-national-security-ministry-says-3382313","summary":"Clear negative: the state acknowledged blocking X around the election period on national-security grounds. That directly restricted criticism, reporting, and civil-society communication.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.8"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Widening Crackdown on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"Clear negative: HRW said the government clamped down on dissenting media, the opposition, and NGOs, while media pressure and lack of safeguards deepened self-censorship. This is strong evidence against tolerating criticism or monitoring.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.8","3B.10"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Civil Society Joint Statement Responding to Network Shutdowns and Platform Blocking","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-15","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/asa33/7834/2024/en/","summary":"Negative for tolerance: civil-society organizations jointly protested the X block and election-related shutdowns, showing that monitoring voices were active but being obstructed by state controls.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.8"]},{"title":"Pakistan: The new Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Act threatens the right to protest","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-09","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/pakistan-the-new-peaceful-assembly-and-public-order-act-threatens-the-right-to-protest/","summary":"Clear negative: Amnesty said the government rushed through a law that criminalized peaceful assembly and expanded powers to restrict gatherings. This is direct evidence against tolerance for protest and civil-society monitoring.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Pakistan Government Intensifies Crackdown on Political Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-10-09","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/09/pakistan-government-intensifies-crackdown-political-dissent","summary":"Clear negative: HRW reported mass arrests, tear gas, roadblocks, and mobile-internet cuts against PTI protesters, including peaceful demonstrators. That is coercive suppression, not tolerance.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Repeated punitive crackdowns on Baloch protests must end","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/pakistan-repeated-punitive-crackdowns-on-baloch-protests-must-end/","summary":"Clear negative: Amnesty described deaths, mass arrests, roadblocks, and network shutdowns against Baloch protesters. This is strong evidence that civil-society protest was met with punishment, not tolerance.","question_ids":["4B.3","3B.8","3B.9","3B.10"]},{"title":"Pakistan: Urgent and transparent investigation needed into deadly crackdown on opposition protesters","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-11-27","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/urgent-and-transparent-investigation-needed-into-deadly-crackdown-on-opposition-protesters/","summary":"Clear negative: Amnesty reported deaths, mass detentions, shutdowns, and a pattern of intolerance toward peaceful opposition assembly. That directly undercuts a tolerance reading for investigative journalism and criticism.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.2","3B.4","3B.8"]}]}
